design.name: 磐 curled-up scale ball (entrance form)
design.role: 磐出场演出的鳞球形态，单独模型，砸地后切换成本体
design.turnaround_lead: the pangolin hero from the sheet completely CURLED UP into a tight armoured ball, like a real rolled-up pangolin: an almost perfect sphere about 1.15 m across made only of his big overlapping bronze-olive scales with gold edges and thin glowing amber seams, the broad scaled tail wrapped all the way around the outside sealing the ball, NO face, arms, legs, clothes, gun or apron visible (everything tucked inside), only a hint of the saffron robe and teal sash peeking out between two scale rows on one side
design.turnaround_pose: ; the ball rests on its bottom, the tail tip lies over the top-front of the ball
design.turnaround_digits: No hands, feet or face visible anywhere.
